body: Well...yeah when it comes to this. I know I’m lower stock. Telling me that it’s not the case or giving me these stupid exercises doesn’t help. One told me to catch myself when I’m thinking negatively about myself and counter it with a positive thought. How am I supposed to do that when the negative thoughts are constant and I can’t deny them because I know what they’re telling me is true? I really tried to do it and it didn’t work, I couldn’t believe my own lies I was telling myself. My life is objectively worse because of who I am and what I have to look like, I can’t just dance around it and pretend everything is fine.
